2026-03-10.title: Remove deprecated rate property from rate limit endpoint
Remove deprecated permission property from request when a team is created
Updates the "Get repository content" API, so that, when listing the contents of a directory, submodules have the type "submodule" instead of the type "file"
Change pre_receive_hook_id path parameter type from integer to string
Change Content-Type of SARIF response
Remove deprecated use_squash_pr_title_as_default property from repo settings endpoints
Remove authorizations_url from the API root (GET /)
Deprecate support for the beta media type
Change custom repository role endpoint paths to be more descriptive about the resource
This changeset removes the underspecified fields history and forks from the base-gist object
Change success status code from 204 to 202 for deleting an installation
Remove secret_scanning_push_protection_custom_link_enabled from the organization request and response
Remove javascript and typescript values from the languages enum in code scanning default setup responses, in favor of javascript-typescript
Remove deprecated has_downloads property from Repository response
Change create repository response from 422 to 451 when blocked by trade controls
Change delete organization response from 403 to 451 when blocked by trade controls
Change remove organization member response from 403 to 451 when blocked by trade controls
Change update organization membership response from 403 to 451 when blocked by trade controls
Change accept repository invitation response from 403 to 451 when blocked by trade controls
Remove deprecated hub_url property from API root response
Deprecate cvss property in favor of cvss_severities for advisory APIs
Remove repository detail fields from migration resource responses
Remove deprecated /hub endpoint
Remove merge_commit_sha field from pull request responses
Change workflow dispatch response from 204 to 200 with workflow run details
Remove deprecated singular "assignee" field from Issue and Pull Request endpoints
Change selected_repository_ids parameter to only accept integers for Dependabot org secrets
Remove the bundle property from attestation list responses

changes.description: `user` will be removed. Use the `assignee` field instead.
`user` will be removed. Use the `assignee` field instead.
`timeline` will be removed. Use Issue.timelineItems instead.
`timeline` will be removed. Use PullRequest.timelineItems instead.
`DRAFT` will be removed. Use PullRequest.isDraft instead.
`users` will be removed. Use the `reactors` field instead.
`dependencyEcosystem` will be removed. Use the ecosystem argument instead.
`packageLabel` will be removed. Use normalized `packageName` field instead.
`visibleFields` will be removed. Check out the `ProjectV2View#fields` API as an example for the more capable alternative.
`groupBy` will be removed. Check out the `ProjectV2View#group_by_fields` API as an example for the more capable alternative.
`sortBy` will be removed. Check out the `ProjectV2View#sort_by_fields` API as an example for the more capable alternative.
`verticalGroupBy` will be removed. Check out the `ProjectV2View#vertical_group_by_fields` API as an example for the more capable alternative.
`field` will be removed. Check out the `ProjectV2ItemFieldGroup#groupByField` API as an example for the more capable alternative.
`body` will be removed. use addPullRequestReviewThread or addPullRequestReviewThreadReply instead
`commitOID` will be removed. use addPullRequestReviewThread or addPullRequestReviewThreadReply instead
`inReplyTo` will be removed. use addPullRequestReviewThread or addPullRequestReviewThreadReply instead
`path` will be removed. use addPullRequestReviewThread or addPullRequestReviewThreadReply instead
`position` will be removed. use addPullRequestReviewThread or addPullRequestReviewThreadReply instead
`pullRequestId` will be removed. use addPullRequestReviewThread or addPullRequestReviewThreadReply instead
`pullRequestReviewId` will be removed. use addPullRequestReviewThread or addPullRequestReviewThreadReply instead
`comments` will be removed. use the `threads` argument instead
`position` will be removed. Use the `line` and `startLine` fields instead, which are file line numbers instead of diff line numbers
`teamDiscussionsSetting` will be removed. Follow the guide at https://github.blog/changelog/2023-02-08-sunset-notice-team-discussions/ to find a suitable replacement.
`inviter` will be removed. `inviter` will be replaced by `inviterActor`.
`expiresAt` will be removed. Do not rely on this field, it is currently set to a date far in the future if a device key is expirationless
`cvss` will be removed. New `cvss_severities` field will now contain both `cvss_v3` and `cvss_v4` properties.
`list` will be removed. Use the `optionalList` field instead.
`subject` will be removed. Use the `optionalSubject` field instead.
`type` will be removed. Use `codingAgentFilter` and `codingAgentTypeFilter` instead.
`viewerRelevantRepositories` will be removed. Use viewerCopilotChatRepositorySuggestions instead.
